description: Add a clean caption bar to the top or bottom of any photo — with font size, colors and padding controls.

faqs.a: Yes — the bar becomes part of the image itself, so it shows up everywhere the image is shared.
faqs.q: Is the caption burned into the image?

faqs.a: The bar height grows automatically with the font size and padding you choose.
faqs.q: How tall is the caption bar?

faqs.a: No — your photo stays on your device; the caption is drawn on a canvas in your browser.

howto: Pick top or bottom placement, font size and colors.
Click "Download image" to save the PNG.
title: Image Caption Adder
